source_integrity.label_repair_scope: Change seven labels only in ssp_profiles2017.json and reference.ssp_labels if coordinated; importer repair must not regenerate broad mapping/courses or change unrelated historical content. Keep all other 258 labels byte-equal when doing narrow corrective patch.

set_cover.interpretation: Incidence coverage of an unvalidated pedagogical mapping only; neither completeness of differential diagnoses, quality of clinical content, nor minimal/optimal course set. 291 is stale for this tree.
limitations: Broad code range rules in import_nosology.py distribute identical SSP lists to all codes in a range without per-link evidence.
MANUAL inserts proposed links into coverage before any clinical validation.
Frequent and filled categories are preselected; 291/398 are not a minimal solution of clinical needs.
Greedy set cover need not be optimal. Tie key uses only first letter (-ord(c[0])), not full code as docstring claims; glob/order can affect tied choices.
A title, symptom mention or quiz question alone does not prove a structured diagnostic pathway.
Printed SSP list includes care, consent, safeguarding, screening and context: these must not be turned into causal diseases to force 265/265.

causal_diagnosis.criterion: A defined disease/syndrome can explain the SSP presentation or finding, supported by explicit clinical source in a stated population/context.

differential_diagnosis.criterion: Clinically plausible alternative to evaluate/exclude for this presentation. Document discriminating findings, initial tests, urgency or referral; do not confuse a pathology course own differential with SSP-wide differential coverage.

contextual_notion.criterion: Risk factor, mechanism, complication, incidental association or care context, without demonstrated causal/differential relevance to this SSP. Can be useful teaching content but supplies no diagnostic coverage claim.

competency_or_care_pathway.criterion: Consent, refusal, communication, prevention/screening, social issues, safeguarding, rehabilitation, interprofessional error or end-of-life task. Dedicated transversal learning objective/scenario; no invented disease equivalence.

outside_current_scope.criterion: Belongs to another discipline/system, or needs specialist training beyond intended level. Record destination and rationale; not same as unrequired by exam and never counted covered in these four systems.

unresolved.criterion: Source not found/read or link clinically uncertain; preserve proposal as unvalidated and exclude from accepted coverage.

validation_procedure: Freeze source commit, source file digests, PROFILES label and page, 4-system catalogue and precise review scope.
For each proposed SSP-category edge, assign relation type and context (age, setting, acute/chronic, pregnancy, severity); category must use official three-character CIM-10-GM 2024 terminology.

Read source section itself: prioritize Swiss primary clinical guidance, then European; record issuing body, version/date, exact page/section, brief supporting passage and retrieval date. URL accessibility alone is not medical evidence.

Record necessity: common, urgent/not-to-miss, otherwise relevant PROFILES context. Do not infer a mapping from shared word, broad range or indirect mention. Separate uncertainty and contradictory sources.
Independent reviewer checks link meaning and evidence; status proposed/accepted/rejected/unresolved, reviewer identity, date and evidence hash. No accepted status without completed verification.

For accepted clinical links, locate actual course section/scenario for SSP workup, discrimination, initial actions and red flags. Existence in catalogue/planned course is separate from teaching delivered and verified.
Review expected SSP differential set and context variation explicitly. At least one link per SSP is an incidence check only; do not call differential clinically complete solely from that.

Output matrix with original label, accepted causal links, accepted differential links, contextual/competency links, excluded scope, unresolved items and source/course anchors. Show diagnostic incidence, pathway teaching and clinical validation as separate counters.
deduplication: Normalize validated disease code to exactly [A-Z][0-9]{2}; dotted subcodes enrich category course rather than creating additional counted courses. Validate official category membership before truncating; reject invalid raw codes.
Use canonical course identity plus explicit chapters.json covers mapping reviewed for actual scope. Several SSPs/clinical relations do not create duplicate courses.
A covers declaration is not proof all linked diagnoses are actually taught. Track the covered diagnosis set separately from course count and verify anchors.
Catalogue primary fragment determines single ownership; cross-system references are links, not duplicate courses. Same course may teach several diseases only when justified and documented.

For accepted additions already present as integrated course/draft, enrich/review existing course. Count requested additions, newly missing categories, new course units, integrated units and validated units separately.

conservative_post_additions_calculation.inputs: Frozen current C0 categories; four independently reviewed lists A08,A05,A04,A06; accepted typed/proven clinical edges; canonical course ownership and explicitly verified covers.
conservative_post_additions_calculation.category_formula: Cprovisional = C0 union accepted causal/differential category additions. Delta_categories = accepted_additions minus C0. Union before counting; never sum four raw counts.
conservative_post_additions_calculation.course_formula: Course units = number of distinct canonical course ids assigned to Cprovisional after verified covers; do not subtract a course because an unverified covers field claims it.
conservative_post_additions_calculation.safety: Do not remove existing baseline categories merely to restore an old total. Suspect old links become unresolved; baseline courses remain pending their own justification. Context/competency items have their own ledger, not a false pathology count.
conservative_post_additions_calculation.reporting: Publish old stored 291 vs current reproducible 398 as distinct figures, plus verified additions/overlap and provisional new total. Keep 265 as official SSP denominator; four-system scope is a subset and cross-specialty gaps remain visible.
conservative_post_additions_calculation.completion_limit: No final post-additions total asserted here: the four clinical audit results must be reconciled and their accepted categories deduplicated. Never label unreviewed mapping clinical validation.

github_minimal_enforcement_checklist: Keep implementation local and reviewable first. Prepare explicit active main-targeted ruleset or legacy protection payload: require PR, required guard status from expected App, strict/up-to-date checks, linear history, no force-push, no deletion, no bypass (legacy enforce_admins true). Confirm squash or rebase merge allowed.

Do not enable restrict_updates without planning merge actor bypass: it blocks all updates except bypass actors, including normal PR merges. Require PR+checks is the main rule for no direct main pushes. Avoid blanket app bypass.

On personal public Medina, use strict required checks plus serial merges; merge queue and legacy actor push restrictions are not available for this ownership. Moving to an organization is a separate decision, not done here.

Trusted guard code/workflow/registry must come from immutable trusted base commit, not PR branch. Read diff and registry changes as data only. No PR imports, local actions, package hooks, test commands or PR-supplied artifacts in privileged workflow.
Protect governance/control changes themselves with separate review and immutable base rules; a PR must not authorize its own registry entry, veto release, policy relaxation or forged receipt.

Required check must be attached explicitly to the exact current PR head (and revision/base used recorded); a pull_request_target automatic check is normally on default branch SHA, so implement an explicit head status/check reporter or verify attribution carefully.

Expected GitHub Actions app does not distinguish trusted workflow from malicious sibling workflow using same app/context. For stronger anti-spoofing, use a dedicated GitHub App reporter whose credential is unavailable to PR workflows and repository writers, or an available organization-enforced required workflow. Do not claim current personal-repo YAML alone makes check provenance inviolable.

Always run final verdict job and fail unless every mandatory result is exactly success, expected evidence exists and schema/identity/revision checks pass. No continue-on-error, || true, unsupported-event pass, or catch-all exception success. Skipped/neutral may satisfy GitHub protection so never use them as positive guard conclusion.

No workflow paths filter or job-level conditional that allows required guard to skip. Include relevant lifecycle events (opened/synchronize/reopened/edited/ready_for_review as appropriate), reject unsupported states and stale head/base. Sanitize title/branch/body strings: pass as data, never shell interpolation.

Pin actions by commit SHA; least privilege; no persist-credentials for untrusted checkout; no secrets or privileged caches exposed to untrusted PR code. A read-only static guard can use base-owned workflow to fetch git objects and parse diff without executing head.

Validate mission in trusted base registry: active/not expired, unique mission/session, authenticated GitHub actor+PR author+head repo numeric id+branch+course/role+base SHA+allowed paths; path overlaps against all other active missions. Reject rename/delete escapes, untracked/generated shared paths, malicious symlinks and self-authored registry proof.

Fork policy explicit: simplest deny head.repo.id different from base.repo.id unless trusted approved registration binds exact fork/actor/branch. Public forks cannot generally be prevented; merging their unauthorized content can be denied.

Actor labels Codex/Claude/session ids/branch prefixes are declarations, not authenticated identity. Shared GitHub credential cannot prove which model/session acted. Require distinct actual identities for strong separation or state operational limitation.

Conflict control must use latest base registry and reject stale base; deterministic revalidation after main advances, serial integration, no merging stale successful receipt. Status must bind head and effective base/registry revision.

After authorized settings access is actually available, apply reviewed payload and GET/read back rules, expected status source, bypass list, target and enforcement. Run controlled negative demonstrations: direct push rejected; wrong/unregistered/fork/conflicting path refused; tampered guard/receipt/registry refused; stale SHA and skipped upstream refused; valid assigned PR succeeds. Never report enforced before these observations.

Owner/admin can edit/delete rules, alter workflows or permissions, uninstall Apps or change ownership. Include-admin/no-bypass constrains normal operations while configured; no inviolability guarantee against platform administrator. Local hooks and AI guard cannot alone constrain direct remote/API operations.
